newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Dragon Oil in gas discovery in Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Dragon Oil in gas discovery in Thailand.

text.p: Dragon Oil Plc said on Thursday that its wholly-owned Thai subsidiary, Songkhla Resources Ltd, and Texaco Exploration Thailand II Ltd, its partner, had made a gas discovery in the Bussagong 2X well on its B12/32 concession in the Gulf of Thailand.
The well was drilled to a vertical depth of 8,570 feet subsea and intersected a number of hydrocarbon bearing zones.
A select number of the identified hydrocarbon bearing intervals were tested by three drill stem tests, Dragon said in a statement.
A maximum flow rate of 21 million cubic feet of gas per day, together with 115 barrels of gas condensate per day, was achieved from one of the tested zones.
"The results of these tests are being evaluated to determine the future work programme on the concession," Dragon said.
Songkhla holds a 35 percent interest in the well while Texaco Exploration holds the remaining 65 percent.
